info.name: Returns the number of active customers

items.docs: This endpoint returns the number of customers with active status within Antavo.

info.name: Returns detailed customer data using the Antavo unique ID

params.name: customer_id
params.description:
Unique customer ID. This can be 

* The Antavo unique ID e.g., `280e674c-c4ea-4a30-987a-d9267d1a5018`
* An external ID (requires [configuration](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/customers#external-identifiers)): `{external_field:external_id_value}`

params.name: fields
params.description:
Returns additional optional fields: 

* Groups: Returns associated groups (requires [User groups module](https://docs.antavo.com/docs/user-groups) for selected customer in the form of an object with the following properties:
  
  - `ID` - integer

  - `Name` - string, optional (not returned for non-existing groups)
  
  - `external_id` - string, optional (not returned if empty)

* Purchases: A summary of purchase statistics. Options are [here](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/customers#purchases).

* Expiring points: A summary of expiration statistics. Options are [here](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/customers#expiring-points).

* Expiration points history: An array of dates and number of points that have expired or will expire. Options are [here](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/customers#expiring-points).

items.docs: This endpoint returns detailed information for a specific customer.

info.name: Search Antavo database using customer filters

params.name: Filtering
params.description:
Customers can be filtered upon any configured customer field (marked as ``searchable``). Results are case-sensitive and return exact matches.

It's possible to query multiple customers based on the last update date. Customer IDs are returned if the  ``updated_at`` customer attribute is greater than a specified datetime using the format ``updated_at.gt=<datetime>``.

params.name: search
params.description: Perform searches using key fields such as `first_name`, `last_name`,  `email`, `mobile_phone`, or `membership_id`.

params.name: fields
params.description:
Returns additional optional attributes from the customer object.

**Note**: Separating commas must be percentage encoded for [API signing](/api-signing).

params.name: match
params.description: Enables querying specific customer data. Currently only works with the following attributes: `_id`, `email`, and `membership_id`. Example usage: `&match=exact&membership_id=33492206-ba75-4487-8047-a9d78a135ce9`

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of events to be returned in one response. Other values are accessible by pagination made accessible via the offset.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the starting number of items for pagination.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to search the Antavo database for customers based on specific criteria and returns the Antavo Customer ID. Note that the filtering is case-sensitive and does not support partial matches.
The filtering query requires that the filter parameter has been tagged as [searchable](https://docs.antavo.com/customers#add-a-new-field) in the Antavo Management UI.

info.name: Merges the current customer into the target account

params.name: customer_id
params.description:
Unique customer ID. This can be 

* The Antavo unique ID e.g., ``280e674c-c4ea-4a30-987a-d9267d1a5018``

* An external ID (requires [configuration](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/customers#external-identifiers)): ``{external_field:external_id_value}``

items.docs: This endpoint permanently merges the current customer into the target account.
